sources.title: GitHub - navopw/laya-onnx: Local multilingual typed decisions with ONNX ...
sources.snippet: Laya ONNX serves POST /v1/systemone, the same wire format as api.typesafe.ai and OpenRouter's typesafe/jev-* models, backed by the Laya multilingual decision model on ONNX Runtime. Send a state and typed questions; get choices, probability distributions, ordinal scores, and boolean probabilities back.

sources.title: Mattepiu/laya-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Laya (Base model) Laya is an open-source, non-autoregressive System 1 decision model: give it a state (text, email, ticket, or JSON document) and typed questions, and it returns typed answers with mathematically calibrated probabilities and confidence scores.

sources.title: Laya: open-source alternative to TypeSafe Jev, runs locally
sources.snippet: Laya is the open-source alternative to TypeSafe Jev: a small model that decides instead of chatting. Typed answers with real probabilities in 21 ms, on your own machine.

sources.title: Laya — 33ms Multilingual System 1 Decision Engine
sources.snippet: Instead of staying bitter, I decided to take everything I learned, fix every architectural limitation of the old approach, and build a completely open, horizontal System 1 decision model family: Laya.
